sources.title: MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI: T2V, I2V, and R2V Video Workflows
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model, now available as open weights. It jointly understands text, images, video, and audio in a single context, and generates video with native stereo audio: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled together in a single forward pass instead of being layered on afterward.
